description.p1: Read your PRUNplanner data from sheets, scripts and AI assistants. See the {link}.
description.warning: Treat a key like your password: it reads all your planning data, and a read & write key can also change it. {link}

get_started.title: Get started
get_started.step_create: Create a key below and save it somewhere safe.
get_started.step_pick: Pick what you want in the URL builder, for example your empire's material I/O.
get_started.step_paste: Copy the Google Sheets formula, the URL or a curl or Python snippet and paste it into your sheet or script.

builder.title: URL builder

empty.cx: You have no CX preferences yet.

builder.incomplete: Fill in every input above to build the URL.
builder.placeholder_note: {placeholder} stands for your key. Create a key and choose "Use in URL builder" to fill it in.
builder.freshness: From the last time PRUNplanner calculated this empire. The updated_at column shows when.
builder.key_warning: Anyone who can open this sheet can read your data with this key. A key in a URL can only read, but use a separate read-only key per sheet so you can revoke it alone.

empire_plans.description: The plans of one empire with planet, COGC, permits and CorpHQ.

fio_storage.label: FIO storage
fio_storage.description: Every material in your FIO storages, warehouses and ships.

exchanges.label: Exchange prices
exchanges.description: Prices and calculated metrics of every material on every exchange.

plans.label: All plans
plans.description: Every plan of your account with its full configuration.

plan.description: One plan with its full configuration.

empires.label: All empires
empires.description: Every empire of your account with its plans.

cxs.label: CX preferences
cxs.description: Every CX preference of your account.

cx.description: One CX preference with its rules.

planet.label: One planet
planet.description: Resources, environment and infrastructure of one planet.

manage.last_used_hint: Requests with this key update this within a few minutes.

confirm_revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
confirm_revoke.content: Scripts and sheets using it stop working at once.

mcp.title: AI assistants (MCP)
mcp.description: Connect Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Copilot, Cursor and other assistants: they read and calculate your plans and empires with PRUNplanner's own engine.
mcp.keys: A Read-only key reads and calculates; a Read & write key also saves plans, empires and preferences.
mcp.setup_link: Set up Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, VS Code, Cursor and more

form.key_description: 나중에 쉽게 알아볼 수 있도록 키에 구분하기 좋은 이름을 지어 주세요.
form.success_note: 보안을 위해 이 키는 다시 표시할 수 없습니다. 키를 분실하면 기존 키를 폐기하고 새 키를 만들어야 합니다.
form.error: API 키를 생성하는 중 오류가 발생했습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해 주세요.

hint.read: Reads your plans, empires and other data. Can't change anything.
hint.read_write: Also creates, changes and deletes your plans, empires and other data.
